tha-ap392:3.1: bhikkhavo → bhikkhave (sya-all) | suṇātha → suṇotha (pts) | Suṇātha → suṇātha bhikkhave mayhaṁ, yaṁ kammaṁ pakataṁ mayā; ekaṁ araññikaṁ bhikkhuṁ, disvā dinnaṁ pilotikaṁ; patthitaṁ paṭhamaṁ buddhaṁ, buddhattāya mayā tadā; pilotiyassa kammassa, buddhattepi vipaccati; gopālako pure āsiṁ, gāviṁ pājeti gocaraṁ; pivantiṁ udakaṁ āvilaṁ, gāviṁ disvā nivārayiṁ; tena kammavipākena, idha pacchimake bhave; vipāsito yadicchakaṁ, na hi pātuṁ labhāmahaṁ (cck: syā.)
tha-ap392:3.4:
buddhattepi → buddhatthe pi (pts) | vipaccati → suṇātha bhikkhave mayhaṁ kammaṁ pakataṁ mayā, 
ekaṁ araññikaṁ bhikkhuṁ disvā dinnaṁ pilotikaṁ. 
patthitaṁ paṭhamaṁ buddhaṁ buddhatatāya mayā tadā, 
pilotikassa kammassa buddhattepi vipaccati 
gopālako pure āsiṁ gāviṁ pājeti gocaraṁ, 
pivantiṁ udakaṁ ācilaṁ gāviṁ disvā nivārayiṁ. 
tena kamamavipākena idha pacchimake bhave, 
pipāsito yadicchakaṁ na hi pātuṁ labhāmahaṁ – syā (bj note) | vipaccati → suṇātha bhikkhave mayhaṁ, yaṁ kammaṁ pakataṁ mayā; ekaṁ araññikaṁ bhikkhuṁ, disvā dinnaṁ pilotikaṁ; patthitaṁ paṭhamaṁ buddhaṁ, buddhattāya mayā tadā; pilotiyassa kammassa, buddhattepi vipaccati; gopālako pure āsiṁ, gāviṁ pājeti gocaraṁ; pivantiṁ udakaṁ āvilaṁ, gāviṁ disvā nivārayiṁ; tena kammavipākena, idha pacchimake bhave; vipāsito yadicchakaṁ, na hi pātuṁ labhāmahaṁ (cck: syā.)
tha-ap392:4.1: munāḷi → munāḷī (bj) | munāḷi nāmahaṁ → munāli nām ahaṁ (pts)
tha-ap392:4.3: sarabhuṁ → surabhiṁ (bj: machasaṁ) | surabhiṁ → sarabhuṁ (cck: sī.)
tha-ap392:9.3: abbhācikkhi → abbhakkhāsi (bj, pts) | abbhakkhāsi → abbhācikkhi (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap392:11.1: isi bhīmo → isībhimo (sya-all) | Tatthāgato → tamāgato (cck: ka.)
tha-ap392:13.2: bhikkhamānaṁ → bhikkhamānā (bj, sya-all) | bhikkhamānaṁ kule kule → bhikkhamānā kulākule (pts) | bhikkhamānā → bhikkhamānaṁ (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap392:17.4: khipiṁ → dahiṁ (sya-all) | khipiṁ → dabhiṁ (bj: syā) | sakalikaṁ → sakkhalikaṁ (cck: ka.) | khipiṁ → dahiṁ (cck: syā.)
tha-ap392:20.4: samupāgami → mam upāgamī (pts) | upāgami → samupāgami (bj: machasaṁ) | samupāgami → maṁ upāgami (cck: sī.)
tha-ap392:21.1: patthivo → pattiko (sya-all) | patthivo → pattiko (bj: syā) | patthivo → pattiko (cck: syā. ka.); khattiyo (cck: udāna aṭṭha.)
tha-ap392:22.3: pakopesi → pakappesi (bj: machasaṁ) | pakappesi → pakopesi (cck: sī.)
tha-ap392:24.2: ahū → ahu (sya-all) | sīsadukkhaṁ ahū → sīsadukkham ahu (pts)
tha-ap392:24.3: sabbe sakkā ca haññiṁsu → sakkesu haññamānesu (sya-all, pts)
tha-ap392:24.4: viṭaṭūbho → viṭaṭubho (sya-all) | viḍūḍabho → viḍḍubho (bj: machasaṁ) | viṭaṭūbho → viṭaṭubho (cck: syā. ka.)
tha-ap392:25.4: sālayo → sāliyo (sya-all, pts) | sālayo → sāliyo (bj: sīmu)
tha-ap392:27.2: niheṭhayiṁ → nisedhayiṁ (sya-all) | niheṭhayiṁ → nisedhayiṁ (bj: syā) | niheṭhayiṁ → nisedhayiṁ (cck: syā. ka.)
tha-ap392:27.4: ahū mama → mamaṁ ahuṁ (bj) | ahū → ahu (sya-all) | piṭṭhidukkhaṁ ahū → piṭṭhidukkham ahu (pts)
tha-ap392:31.4: vārito → cārito (bj); codito (sya-all) | vārito puññapāpaparikkhīṇo → kārito puññapāpaparikhīṇo (pts)
tha-ap392:34.1: buddhāpadānadhammapariyāyaṁ abhāsitthāti → dhammapariyāyaṁ abhāsi (bj) | pubbakammapilotikaṁ → kammapilotikaṁ (bj: machasaṁ)
